inner_doc_import_order_context_changes.doc: //! Version export admission over actual original T/E and publication owners.
//! PublicationFixture is an existing completed mechanism fixture, not the new
//! Fresh Root ten-owner path. All role credentials and B measurements remain
//! test inputs. Corruptions edit only untrusted cold expected metadata.
//! Actual published Version -> original read-only T/E alias mechanisms.
//! PublicationFixture performs its original T/B/NoUpdate publication. Its
//! same-process transport and enrolled fixture credentials are explicit;
//! these tests do not prove Fresh Root execution or public four-slot admission.
//! Test-only observation of an actual local owner response.
//! The gate cannot supply or change a response, counter, permit or deadline.
//! Release/Drop only stops the pause; callers still await the original worker
//! terminal observation and the original fixture peer joins.
//! Staged, mechanism-only B/retention over an actual Fresh Bootstrap T.
//! Registration precedes T. Neither constructor runs PositiveFixture's
//! auxiliary Evaluation/Model path. The two real Trainer servers remain owned
//! by OriginalTrainingPeers outside this fixture and are explicitly joined.
//! First test-control admission from pre-held Root policy and complete original
//! evidence. Pending authenticates the report; only the original E/D commands
//! can bind its completion claim to the still-live original Source. No new
//! writer, Source publication, Root intent, lease or Training capability exists here.
//! Actual same-A signatures exercise the first-report verifier. This local
//! mechanism test supplies trusted fixture policy before encoding the report;
//! it does not claim three-UID Root admission or execution of E/D/T.
//! Test-control serialization of already held original Material constructor
//! inputs. The parent verifier, scope and exact freeze predate the report.
//! This is not a production authority format or a way to reconstruct an owner.
//! Advance the same Fresh Material/T/B owners through Version and S. The
//! transport adapters are explicit same-process fixtures. C is installed once
//! here, but only the original daemon/control path may dispatch its RunStart.
//! Real Fresh A/Material/T/B/Version/S, with explicit fixture credentials and a
//! genuine UID-0 issuer socket. This case deliberately leaves C unstarted; the
//! dual-process daemon/Root case must dispatch its retained signed RunStart.
//! Preserve original Fresh custody while advancing actual Material -> T -> B.
//! Every response is produced by the original owner. This local fixture uses
//! existing same-process adapters, not public different-UID admission.
//! Staged Fresh mechanism: no completed Positive/Publication fixture is used.
//! Original clocks, role credentials and independently fixed outcomes are test
//! data, not a real external B measurement or a deployed Root qualification.
//! Fixed twenty role rights and one original Root pidfd. Old handoff limits
//! and both existing two-right purposes are deliberately unchanged.
